scope: Fixes from the final pre-merge review: private-signal capture rebind (mips, mips64, ppc), position lock across staged reads, x86 AP start-block identity check, static step candidates, docs. Native OS distro boot on all ten profiles, Linux-personality musl stress on ppc/mips/mips64 at 1 vCPU, SMP gates on x86_64/aarch64/rv64, kernel lanes, native probes, hosted suite, OS tool suite.

runs.command: xmake qemu-distro --fs=simplefs --require-native --timeout=300 --display=none (OS copy against the debug SDK) on i386 x86_64 aarch64 arm32 rv64 rv32 loongarch64 mips mips64 ppc
runs.result: 10 of 10 OK_USERLAND scope=hardware acceptance=pass; baseline 3c5ef19: mips and mips64 fail (private capture readiness missing)
SMP_STRESS_PASS files=480 messages=960 forks=480 on all three

runs.result: all pass, assertion counters 0; hotplug cycles 501/961/884, failures 0
